title: Law to expand delivery worker safety rules to e-bikes, mopeds, motorcycles
summary: This bill would broaden the city's commercial bicycle safety law to cover other delivery devices, including electric bicycles, mopeds and motorcycles. Businesses using these devices for deliveries would have to provide safety equipment, identification cards and a safety course to delivery workers and keep records of who delivers for them. It also repeals an older section of the code requiring signs with bicycle safety procedures.
